# Buy House in Italy

> Property-finding service for international buyers who want to purchase a home in Italy, run by the Italian estate agency Oikos Immobiliare. The buyer describes what they want; a consultant turns it into a written wishlist (must haves, nice to haves, deal breakers), finds matching properties through Oikos, partner agencies and other sources, and coordinates the purchase up to the notary deed and after-sale services.

Key points:
- The site exists to understand what the buyer wants. It publishes no property catalogue: properties are matched privately against each buyer's brief.
- Ways to start: a guided chat interview, a voice interview, or a video call with a consultant.
- If no property in the database matches, the search continues through partner agencies, colleagues and other sources.
- Legal and tax figures on the guides are indicative and must be confirmed with a notary, lawyer or tax adviser.
- Other languages: Italiano (https://buyhouseinitaly.example/it/), Deutsch (https://buyhouseinitaly.example/de/), Français (https://buyhouseinitaly.example/fr/), Nederlands (https://buyhouseinitaly.example/nl/), Español (https://buyhouseinitaly.example/es/).

## Start here

- [Home](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/): Tell us what you're looking for in Italy. A consultant from Oikos Immobiliare turns it into a written brief, finds matching homes and guides you through the purchase.
- [Start your search](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/start/): Three ways to tell us what you're looking for in Italy: a guided chat, a voice interview or a video call with a consultant. Each ends in a written brief you can edit.
- [What we take care of](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/): What we organise for foreign buyers in Italy: search, visits, negotiation, checks, notary, codice fiscale, mortgages, currency, escrow and relocation.
- [About us](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/about/): Buy House in Italy is a property-finding service for international buyers, run by the Italian estate agency Oikos Immobiliare. How we work and who you'll speak to.
- [For partner agencies](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/partner-agencies/): Estate agencies in Italy can share listings with Buy House in Italy for free. When we introduce a buyer who completes, the agency shares part of its commission.
- [Contact us](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/contact/): Write to a Buy House in Italy consultant about buying a home in Italy or about a specific property, or start with the guided interview or a video call.

## Services

- [Property search](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/property-search/): How we search for a home in Italy from your brief: Oikos listings, partner agencies, colleagues and other sources, with a shortlist that explains each match.
- [Visits](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/visits/): How we plan property viewings in Italy for buyers who live abroad: video tours for a first look, grouped viewing trips and notes after every visit.
- [Negotiation support](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/negotiation/): How a purchase offer works in Italy, what it should contain and how we negotiate price and conditions for foreign buyers.
- [Legal assistance](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/legal-assistance/): The difference between the notary and your own lawyer when buying property in Italy, when a lawyer is worth it and how we work with independent lawyers.
- [Technical and legal due diligence](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/due-diligence/): Checks to run before buying property in Italy: land registry and plans, mortgages and liens, planning compliance, energy certificate and building condition.
- [The notary](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/notary/): What the Italian notary does in a property purchase, who chooses and pays them, the interpreter rule and signing by power of attorney.
- [Codice fiscale](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/codice-fiscale/): What the Italian codice fiscale is, why you need it to buy property, and how to get it at an Italian consulate or an Agenzia delle Entrate office.
- [Translations](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/translations/): Which documents to translate when buying property in Italy, working versus sworn translations, and the interpreter required at the notary's deed.
- [Mortgages for foreign buyers](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/mortgages/): What to expect when applying for an Italian mortgage as a non-resident: documents, valuation, timing, the mortgage deed and the substitute tax.
- [Currency exchange](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/currency-exchange/): How to move money into euros for an Italian property purchase: bank transfers, currency providers, forward contracts, traceable payments and anti-money-laundering checks.
- [Escrow](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/escrow/): How the Italian notary's dedicated account works as escrow for a property purchase, when to use it, and how to protect deposits paid before the deed.
- [Architects, surveyors and builders](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/architects-surveyors-builders/): Who does what in an Italian renovation, the feasibility check before you buy, the main building permits and how we follow the works while you are abroad.
- [Utilities and after-sale services](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/utilities-after-sale/): What to set up after buying a home in Italy: utility transfers, internet, waste tax, IMU deadlines, insurance, maintenance and short-term rental registration.
- [Relocation](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/services/relocation/): Moving to Italy after buying property: residence registration for EU citizens, visas and residence permits for non-EU citizens, health care, schools and tax residence.

## Guides

- [The buying process, step by step](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/buying-process/): The steps of buying a home in Italy as a foreign buyer: codice fiscale, checks, purchase offer, preliminary contract and deposit, notary deed and after.
- [Italian property taxes](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/italian-property-taxes/): Italian property taxes explained: purchase tax or VAT, first-home rules, cadastral value, IMU, TARI, rental income, capital gains and inheritance tax.
- [How the Italian notary works](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/italian-notary/): The role of the notary in an Italian property purchase: impartiality, checks, the deed day, interpreters, powers of attorney, fees and what happens after the signing.
- [Financing a property in Italy](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/financing-a-property-in-italy/): How to finance a home in Italy from abroad: the full budget beyond the price, when each payment is due, cash or mortgage, currency and traceable payments.
- [Legal due diligence](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/legal-due-diligence/): The checks before buying a home in Italy: chain of title, mortgages and seizures, cadastral and planning compliance, condominium, constraints, pre-emption.
- [Mortgages for foreign buyers](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/guides/mortgages-for-foreign-buyers/): How to get an Italian mortgage as a non-resident: who can borrow, documents, the bank valuation, fixed or variable rates, timing and costs.

## Where to buy

- [Buying property in Puglia](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/buying-property-in-puglia/): Buying a home in Puglia: Valle d'Itria trulli, masserie near Ostuni, Salento and the coast. Airports, property types, landscape rules and the 7% regime.

## Buying from abroad

- [Buying property in Italy from the USA](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/buying-property-in-italy-from-the-usa/): A guide for Americans buying a home in Italy: reciprocity, the 90/180 rule, codice fiscale, moving dollars, FBAR reporting and the US-Italy tax treaties.
- [Buying property in Italy from the UK](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/buying-property-in-italy-from-the-uk/): A guide for British buyers in Italy after Brexit: reciprocity, the 90/180 rule and visas, codice fiscale, moving pounds and the UK-Italy tax treaty.
- [Buying property in Italy from Germany](https://buyhouseinitaly.example/en/buying-property-in-italy-from-germany/): A guide for German buyers in Italy: EU rights, the Italian notary compared with the German system, protecting deposits, the tax treaty and inheritance tax.
